summary.text: Denise Marcelle is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 61, representing East Baton Rouge, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2015 as the year elected.
The page lists Denise Marcelle with committee assignments including House Select Committee on Women and Children (Vice Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Denise Marcelle's occupation as Director of Community Outreach, Attorney Gordon McKernan, Injury Attorneys.
It lists Denise Marcelle's education as Capital Senior High School; B.A., Criminal Justice, Southern University and A & M College.

The House member page lists Denise Marcelle's committee assignments as Appropriations; House and Governmental Affairs; Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs; House Select Committee on Women and Children (Vice Chair); Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Capital Region Legislative Delegation; Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus.
